headline_findings: Qwen3.8-27B (2026-08-14, Apache-2.0) is the default local quality pick with mature GGUFs; 2-bit fits 8GB VRAM + 32GB RAM via offload.
Gemma 4 E2B/E4B/12B/26B-A4B/31B (Apache-2.0) are the only frontier VL family fully or partly runnable on the reference laptop.
gpt-oss-20b MXFP4 remains the only frontier reasoning model fully usable on 8GB VRAM; 120b needs 64GB+.
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, GLM-5.3/Flash, Hy4, Qwen-Max 2.4T and Mistral Medium 3.5 are API-only on this hardware (300GB-1.5TB weights).
Laguna XS 2.1 (33B-A3B, OpenMDW-1.1) with DFlash drafter is the most promising fast local coding MoE; needs recent llama.cpp.
